title: Account Manager - Medical
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes

  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

What you should have: 

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines

  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts

  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

 

Real Chemistry is proud to be Great Place to Work® certified; check out what our people shared about our culture and workplace on our Great Places to Work Profile here.

We believe we can do our best when feeling our best, which is why we’ve put together a benefits program designed to give you the support you and your family need at every stage of life. Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks, tailored to your region. Globally, this includes offices in our key markets with free snacks to keep you running all day long, generous holiday and paid time off, options for private medical, dental, and vison plans, and support in saving for the future. Other perks include mental wellness coaching and support and access to more than 13,000 online classes with LinkedIn Learning.  Learn more about our great benefits and perks and search specific offerings in your region at: www.realchemistrybenefits.com.

At Real Chemistry, we believe we're at our best when we're connected. Our Real Hybrid and Regional Teams (Real HART) approach is designed to foster collaboration, learning, innovation, and meaningful relationships while providing flexibility where appropriate. Because our workforce spans multiple countries, regions, and client needs, work arrangements may vary by role and location. If you require additional flexibility, we welcome an open conversation with your recruiter and our HR team to discuss your needs and determine what may be possible.

title: Hydrographer/Geophysicist
description: The Role We are the explorers. We are the builders. We are the Wayfinders. Bedrock is mapping the unseen world beneath our oceans and building the systems to do it at scale. We're hiring a Hydrographer/Geophysicist to work with some of the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet. You'll process and analyze multibeam, sidescan, magnetometer, and sub-bottom data from Bedrock field tests and commercial operations, and you'll own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality. When something looks strange in a dataset, you'll be the person asking what it tells us about the vehicle, the survey plan, or the seafloor itself. You will also be in front of customers discussing data quality, interpretation, and deliverables, and teaching them how to read what they're seeing and what it's worth. This is a role for someone who relishes that part of the job. And you'll be on the leading edge of the field. Bedrock is working with major governments around the world on how uncertainty and accuracy should be defined in ocean data- literally helping write the book, the policy, and the guidelines. This is the team revolutionizing how the seafloor gets characterized, and you'd have a say in what the next decade of this field looks like. We are hiring for curiosity, speed of learning, and real excitement about seeing the seafloor in higher fidelity than anyone has seen it before. If you have most of what's below and you're hungry to learn the rest, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Data Processing & Quality First-pass analysis of MBES, SSS, magnetometer, and/or sub-bottom profiler data using commercial software (Qimera, Seaview, SonarWiz, Radex, etc.) Own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality- first pass gets us information, not perfection Spot artifacts and anomalies, and reason about what caused them Work with Bedrock leadership and customers to hold the highest data quality standard in the industry Clients & Education Create data products and write-ups for commercial clients Serve as a primary point of contact for data quality issues, interpretations, and deliverables Teach clients about the unique value of AUV data, and what they can do with it- bring them on the journey rather than handing over a file Explain trade-offs, limitations, and uncertainty clearly, directly, and without defensiveness The Leading Edge Contribute to how uncertainty and accuracy get defined in ocean data-work that feeds into government standards, policy, and guidelines Collaborate with product and engineering on iterative improvements to the vehicle and to survey planning Help build the processing workflows that let all of this scale Who You Are You're a curious, fast-learning data person who wants to be on the vanguard of ocean data, and who would rather be in the conversation with the customer than behind it. Experience Experience processing and reporting on at least two of: MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler, using commercial software Comfort with ArcGIS, QGIS, and/or AutoCAD Experience writing data reports for commercial clients Attention to detail- you find the artifact nobody else saw Nice to Have Experience across all four relevant sensor types (MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler) Light coding (Python/SQL) Offshore experience (ship or AUV ops) Certified Hydrographer, Cat A or Cat B; Licensed Surveyor Experience across defense (mine countermeasures, unexploded ordnance), energy (oil & gas, offshore wind), and/or environmental survey How You Operate You learn fast, and you ask good questions when you are uncertain You treat processing as a problem-solving activity, not a checkbox exercise Iterative by instinct, you improve the data and the workflow with every pass Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change You use tools and AI to increase speed, accuracy, and leverage You are comfortable, clear, and collaborative in front of a customer What You Care About The idea of seeing the seafloor in a way no one has seen it before excites you You take pride in craft, clarity, and accuracy You have some connection to the ocean, professional, academic, or personal and you are excited to be around people who dive, sail, build, and explore offshore Not a Fit If... You want the data perfect on the first pass-iterative improvement is our way You are uncomfortable with uncertainty or with rapid changes in priorities You are not interested in learning new tools and approaches You do not want to interface directly with clients, or you see customer education as a distraction from the real work You are looking for predictable hours and firm boundaries around when the work happens. This job will require some nights and weekends around survey campaigns. Estimated compensation for this position is $95,000- $130,000 annually plus equity. Actual salary offered will be based on qualifications, experience, and location (SF and NY being at the high end of the band). If you want to work on the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet and help decide what comes next in this field, we should talk.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Data Analyst

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to join our team here at ClearScore in London. Analysts play a key role within ClearScore, driving strategy and key decision-making, which ultimately benefits our users, partners, and other teams within the business. We’re seeking an adaptable, curious, and challenge-loving individual to join our growing Global Targeting team.

ClearScore has an amazing analytical community which includes Data Analysts, Scientists and Engineers. The community works collaboratively to ensure a landscape in which team members can develop their full potential and deliver maximum business impact.

ClearScore is both a free credit score and report service and the UK’s leading consumer credit marketplace. As a part of the Global Targeting team, you will play a key role in monitoring and reporting on the effectiveness of our Targeting strategy for our users, playing a key part in the formulation, execution and analysis of our experiments, and providing recommendations to drive improvements that drive a better experience for our users.

What you will be doing:

  • Collaborate closely with your Targeting squad members, providing insights into the performance of our various user segments.
  • Deliver data informed and backed recommendations for improvements to our Targeting strategy.
  • Conduct detailed analysis of A/B tests to drive better outcomes for our users across user journeys.
  • Lead in-depth analytics projects, leveraging data to uncover opportunities and address complex business challenges.
  • Develop efficient and effective monitoring and reporting dashboards using SQL, Databricks, and Domo.
  • Leverage advanced AI to automate and scale existing and new analytics processes

Skills we'd love you to have

  • SQL, Excel skills and either R or Python. Knowledge of DBT and analytical tools such as Amplitude is a plus
  • A strong quantitative and numerical skills, as well as a good understanding of hypothesis testing and foundational statistical principles
  • Experience using Domo or other data visualisation tools
  • A desire to learn and enjoy working collaboratively, with a desire to contribute to our culture.
  • You do not need to fit into a stereotype: we are really committed to closing our gender gap and are actively trying to create an environment where you, as an individual, can thrive.
  • A self-starter mindset: curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning. A desire to deeply understand a problem and its importance to the business before attempting to solve it
  • A drive to understand our users, products, and how users interact with them, enhancing your ability to generate meaningful features and solutions relevant to the problem being addressed

Why ClearScore?

ClearScore is the UK's #1 credit score and report app. We are also present in South Africa, Australia and Canada, with more than 20 million users globally and growing fast. title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
description: Who we are Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables. We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi . The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level. We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter , Noah Hollmann , and Sauraj Gambhir , and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun. In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years. The role Most enterprises will never call our API directly. They will meet TabPFN inside the platforms they already run: SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, or their own cloud. How well that works, how fast each release arrives there, and which platforms come next is the job of our Technical Product Manager for Integrations. You take each model release from handover to live across every channel, working with the engineers who build the model and the partner teams who host it. Inside SAP you carry the product side of TabPFN across its platforms, from AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud, and you help build the integration engineering team that will work with you. Several decisions are yours to bring to the table: which announced channels we build next, what a marketplace listing should cost, how support for all of this works. You work directly with our product team, our engineers and the founders, and you report to the CTO. This suits someone who enjoys landing things on a date as much as deciding what to build, and who still likes being close to the code. What you'll do Take every model release live across SAP, the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, on a plan you build with product and engineering. Be the technical counterpart for the partner teams that host TabPFN, from SAP's platform teams to the hyperscaler marketplaces. Shape how TabPFN shows up inside SAP's stack and what the integration engineering team builds first. Bring the open channel decisions to the founders with a recommendation, and stay hands-on: listings, docs, smoke tests, a PR when it is faster than asking. What we're looking for Two or more years as product manager for a platform or integration surface: a product that ships into partners' platforms, or that other companies build on. You have shipped through gates you did not control, landed multi-team releases on dates, and made a large enterprise's process work for a small, fast team. You started as an engineer and never fully stopped: you read code, logs and scan reports without a translator. You are in Berlin or ready to relocate; Freiburg or New York can work. What sets you apart You have shipped into an SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft or Oracle ecosystem, or know the cloud marketplaces from the inside. You have deployed machine learning models and know what GPUs cost. You have worked at a startup, and you use AI tools to take real work off your plate. Life at Prior Labs You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right. Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together. Our Commitments The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are. title: Acoustic Researcher
description: Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille) The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer. Founded by Aymeric (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and Gauthier (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats. France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service. Pelagon is backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised. Why this matters The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem. France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our Acoustic Researcher , you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define. What you'll do Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline. Characterize and classify acoustic signatures of surface and underwater targets; build the ground-truth understanding our multimodal acoustic model is trained against. Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors. Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models. What we look for Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience. Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theory, array processing, time-frequency analysis. Fluent in Python (NumPy/SciPy) for modeling, simulation and analysis; comfortable working with large datasets. A builder's instinct, you want your work deployed at sea, not left in a paper. Bias toward validating ideas against real data. Bonus: prior experience using machine learning on acoustic signals, naval / defense domain experience. Why join now Founding ownership. You'll be one of the first engineers and will define the technical foundation of the company. Meaningful equity comes with that. A mission with weight. This is hardware that protects critical infrastructure and Europe's maritime space. Real things, in the real ocean, fast. You'll see your work in the water within weeks, not years. AI-first, at the edge, in the real world. We train our own models and run them where it counts: in the water, on the device. You'll be solving the edge-ML and power problems most companies only talk about. A sovereign, European deeptech at the inflection point of a market with strong NATO and EU policy momentum behind it. title: Staff Engineer, EU Infrastructure
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Team Our Infrastructure teams build the foundation that engineers at Wolt, Deliveroo, and DoorDash build on: the compute, cloud, and networking capabilities that enable Engineering teams to develop, deploy, and run services at global scale. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. This is an emerging space with plenty of greenfield opportunities. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be a hands-on technical leader for this infrastructure work that crosses team and brand boundaries. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years. What you'll be doing You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We're determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you'll be pivotal in making this reality. Day-to-day in this role you'll: Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost. Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs. Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads. Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently. Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery. Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help. Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general. Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil. Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams. Our humble expectations Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus. Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation. Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on. A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact. Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost. Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction. What we offer Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence. Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company. Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US. Growth. Room to expand your scope, whether through deeper technical leadership or broader cross-domain influence. Great people. Work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse, international environment, mentoring and learning from others. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Works in Progress is Stripe’s magazine of new and underrated ideas to improve the world. We publish an eclectic mix of articles on policy, economics, business, technology, science, history, arts and culture.

Our audience is growing quickly and includes people making things happen, particularly in technology and politics. We are expanding the commercial side of the magazine—including advertising, subscriptions, events and partnerships—and are looking for an ambitious graduate to help us build it.

This is an entry-level commercial role for a recent graduate who is ambitious, organised and excited to learn quickly in a small, entrepreneurial team.

You will work closely with the Director of Commercial and Audiovisual across the magazine’s commercial activity: advertising, subscriptions, events, marketing and partnerships. You will help keep commercial projects moving by conducting research, supporting outreach, maintaining pipelines and trackers, following up with prospective partners, and contributing to growth experiments.

You will learn by doing: writing outbound emails, building target lists, preparing materials, tracking results, joining calls and following up consistently. It is a strong opportunity for someone who wants early exposure to senior commercial work and meaningful responsibility from the start of their career.

What you’ll do

  • Support the advertising sales process, including preparing rate cards, pitch decks, outreach and pipeline materials.
  • Research and build target lists of potential advertisers, sponsors, agencies, founders, investors and partners.
  • Draft clear, thoughtful outbound emails and follow-ups.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, commercial trackers and reporting.
  • Support subscription growth through acquisition and retention ideas, and help measure their effectiveness.
  • Help develop the events business, including sponsor research, partnership outreach and event planning support.
  • Assist with early marketing and growth experiments across paid acquisition, referrals, partnerships, direct mail and audience development.
  • Prepare decks, reports and briefing materials that help commercial conversations move forward.
  • Join meetings and calls with clients, partners and agencies, taking notes and supporting follow-up.
  • Help turn commercial ideas into clear proposals with pricing, positioning and next steps.
  • Work across sales, marketing, events and subscriptions, adapting quickly as priorities evolve.
  • Take on the practical, sometimes unglamorous work needed to help a small business grow.

We’re looking for someone who

  • Is a recent graduate, or has equivalent early-career experience.
  • Is excited by commercial work and motivated by helping ideas turn into revenue.
  • Is interested in sales, marketing, partnerships, media, events or business development.
  • Is highly organised and comfortable managing lists, trackers and multiple follow-ups.

  • Enjoys working in a small team where everyone pitches in.
  • Is comfortable with both high-profile opportunities and repetitive operational work, such as researching prospects and following up on outreach.
  • Has an interest in media, publishing, technology, economics, policy or culture. Previous media or publishing experience is helpful but not required.

Working at Works in Progress

This role is based in London and requires working from the office every day. You will be part of a small, ambitious team that cares deeply about the magazine and its growth. In return, you will get a steep learning curve, close mentorship and the chance to contribute directly to building the commercial future of Works in Progress.

title: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge
description: Product Engineer | Design Engineering Knowledge Location: Cambridge (UK), hybrid with up to 2 remote days per week Team: Product Start date: ASAP About Neural Concept Neural Concept is the engineering intelligence platform used by leading manufacturers in automotive, aerospace, and energy. We combine geometric and physics AI with LLM-based agents so engineering teams can move from customer requirements to validated designs in a fraction of the usual time. About the role Design decisions depend on information that lives outside the CAD model: customer requirements, design rules, manufacturing and assembly constraints, and cost targets. This information is spread across specification documents, handbooks, ERP systems, requirements management tools, and system models. Engineers gather it by hand, often late in the process, and conflicts surface at design reviews or on the production line. We call the capability that closes this gap Design Engineering Knowledge. It connects the design to the information ecosystem around it, so requirements, constraints, and trade-offs are available to engineers and AI agents while they work on the design itself. As a Product Engineer, you will build this capability. Requirements are the first focus area: extracting them from customer specifications and requirements management systems, structuring them, and keeping them traceable. You will then extend the same foundation to design rule checks, Design for Manufacturing (DfM), Design for Assembly (DfA), and Design for Cost, and connect it to the enterprise systems where this knowledge already lives. You will work with the Product Manager, solution engineers, and customer engineering teams, as the primary developer from the first customer conversation to the version running in production. What you will do Build the requirements foundation: ingest customer specifications and RFQ packages, extract requirements with LLM and agent-based pipelines, and keep each one traceable to its source document and page. Extend this foundation to design rules, DfM, DfA, and Design for Cost, turning standards, handbooks, and company know-how into constraints that software and agents can use. Bring requirements, constraints, and trade-offs into the design workflow, so engineers can check a design against them at any stage and see which ones apply to the part they are working on. Build integrations with the systems around the design: requirements management systems, ERP (cost, materials, and supplier data), and system design and MBSE tools for architecture and system-level requirements. Design the data model that links requirements, rules, and constraints to parts, design parameters, and simulation results. Create evaluation sets and quality metrics with customers, so extraction and checking accuracy is measured and improves with every release. Design human-in-the-loop review flows where engineers validate and edit AI output, with versioning and a full audit trail. Spot recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable components of the Neural Concept platform. Who you are Must have Experience building and shipping production Python software in fast-moving, cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience with LLM applications in production: structured outputs, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and evaluation. Experience integrating with enterprise systems through APIs and data models, for example ERP, PLM, or requirements management tools. Experience with document processing, such as PDF parsing, OCR, or information extraction. Strong software practices: testing (pytest), CI, packaging, code review, and git. A product mindset. You talk to users, understand the problem before writing code, and ship in small, measurable steps. Clear, concise communication with both customer engineers and internal teams. Based in Cambridge (UK) or willing to relocate. Nice to have Background in mechanical engineering or physics, with exposure to DfM, DfA, or design-to-cost practices. Familiarity with requirements engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE, SysML). Experience working with CAD data or geometry processing. Experience with vision-language models, vector databases, or search ranking. What you get Ownership of a product capability that customers use in real engineering programs, with direct access to the engineers who use it. A competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale. A collaborative, multicultural team where your work is visible and recognized. Colleagues who share knowledge freely and support each other. A hybrid model and flexible hours. We focus on results and trust you to organize your time. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Business Consultant - Life Sciences Consulting
description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
 
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
 
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. Our Business Consulting team is focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.
 
The Role
We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program (BCDP).
 
We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early. You will collaborate with experienced team members on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions.  
 
In our structured 20 month program, we equip you with the resources to develop the core consulting skills, deep domain expertise, and leadership foundation for long-term career success at Veeva.
 
BCDP spans five core practice areas: Analytics, Commercial, Content, R&D, and Quality. As an Associate Consultant you will align to one of those practices, allowing you to build targeted industry expertise. You will be asked to choose your preferred practice in the application process.
 
You can learn more about our practices and the work we do here.
 
The anticipated start date is September 2027.

Although Veeva is Work from Anywhere, Associate Business Consultants must live within a maximum commuting distance of 45 minutes to 1 hour from Veeva’s Berlin or Frankfurt offices. #LI-Remote #LI-Entry Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. title: Solution Marketing Manager | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: PLOS One Associate Editor - Life Sciences
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America. 

Role Summary 

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all.  

 The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals. This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries. 
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld. 
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments. 
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Handle publication ethics queries. 
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community. 
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset. 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry. 
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral. 
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
  • Able to set priorities and work independently. 

 

Qualifications 

  • A PhD is required. 

 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer 
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones 

 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £35,000 - £38,950 / (US) $67000 to $73,625. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.  

 

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients.

Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other. 
* Now hiring for our April 2027 and September 2027 start dates.

description:

The Role
At Veeva Link, we're building the intelligence layer for life sciences, creating connected data applications that accelerate drug development and significantly improve patient outcomes. Our core belief: combining the highest quality data with state-of-the-art software delivers immense value.
In your role as the Product Manager for Link Key People data, you take ownership sourcing, managing and maintaining data from health care professionals. That ranges from what podcasts they host to what scientific publication they have made. You will use data pipelines, AI and human oversight to provide high quality and compliant data.
This is key data that builds valuable connections between people in life science. Leading to better progress for all humanity.
You will collaborate with our data engineering, data product, and data operations teams.

title: Learning Disabilities Support Worker- Basingstoke
description:
Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services

LOCATION: Fleet, Hampshire

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (including holiday pay).

Shifts -24/7 support, Monday to Sunday

  • Day shifts between 8.00am and 8.00 pm
  • Waking night and sleep-in shift opportunities
  • Support is delivered on a 2:1 basis
  • Drivers required

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Support Worker within Mental Health Services / Support Worker within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference, people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to support a young adult with foetal alcohol spectrum disorder, autism and ADHD to live safely and independently in their own home.

Working as part of a consistent two-person support team, you will provide structured, person-centred care across both daytime and overnight shifts. You will help the individual maintain their independence, access the community, manage daily routines and work towards their personal goals.

The individual has their own vehicle for the support team to drive. At least one Support Worker on every shift must therefore be an approved driver with the appropriate documentation and checks in place.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

What We’re Looking For

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· 12 months UK-based experience in a community setting.

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Confidence in utilising PBS standards within services.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

Apply Today

Ready to start a role where care goes beyond tasks and becomes a relationship? Click Apply Now and our team will be in touch.

For questions, contact us at:

· Email: ldamhapplications@thornburycommunityservices.co.uk

· Phone: 0333 034 1135

title: Allied Health: Respiratory Therapist Clinical Content Reviewer (Part-time, Remote, PRN Position)
description:
Position Overview 

We are seeking Registered Respiratory Therapists to serve as Subject Matter Experts for an AI-powered learning platform supporting learners preparing for respiratory therapy credentialing and practice. 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Evaluate AI-generated content related to cardiopulmonary anatomy and physiology, patient assessment, airway management, oxygen and aerosol therapy, mechanical ventilation, arterial blood gas interpretation, pulmonary function testing, and respiratory pharmacology 
  • Review content on neonatal, pediatric, and adult critical care respiratory management and common cardiopulmonary disease states 
  • Apply structured evaluation metrics to score accuracy, completeness, and clinical applicability 
  • Provide expert feedback to improve clarity, safety, and educational value for respiratory therapy learners 
  • Complete asynchronous evaluations within defined timelines (5 days to 2 weeks) 
  • Participate in periodic evaluation cycles with potential for ad-hoc assignments 

Required Qualifications 

  • Current Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) credential through the National Board for Respiratory Care (NBRC) 
  • Active state respiratory care license (where required by state) in good standing 
  • Graduate of a CoARC-accredited respiratory therapy program (minimum associate degree) 
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in respiratory therapy education, clinical preceptorship, or content review 
  • NBRC specialty credential (e.g., NPS, ACCS, SDS) or experience in critical care, neonatal/pediatric, or pulmonary diagnostics 
  • Familiarity with the NBRC TMC and Clinical Simulation exam content outlines 

Time Commitment 

5–15 hours/week (Minimum quarterly participation) 

Project Details  

  • Duration: 1 year contract (subject to annual renewal) starting ASAP
  • Compensation: $55/hr 
  • Contract Structure: W2 position contracted through a 3rd party agency

title: Learning Disabilities Support Worker - Thornbury
description:
Support Worker within Learning Disability Services

LOCATION: Bristol

PAY RATES: £16.81 - £21.01 per hour (including holiday pay).

Shifts - flexible and available to work across a variety of shifts, including days, nights, and weekends. You must be able to complete short drop-in shifts at least a few times per week.

Make a lasting impact by building meaningful relationships.

At Thornbury Community Services (TCS), we believe exceptional care starts with genuine connections. We’re looking for Support Worker within Learning Disability Services who are committed to making a real difference—people who truly care and want to build long-term partnerships with those they support.

This isn’t just a job; it’s an opportunity to empower an individual with Cerebral Palsy & Learning Disability to live safe, fulfilled lives. You’ll help clients achieve personal goals, explore new hobbies, and enjoy trips into the community—all while creating relationships that bring lasting satisfaction for both you and them.

We are looking for a compassionate and patient Support Worker to support a gentleman to live an active and fulfilling life. This role involves providing personal care, including assistance with hoisting, showering, toileting, mobility, and medication support. Experience with medication administration is essential. You will support him to enjoy his interests, including sports, technology, creative storytelling, gardening, and accessing the local community. You will also provide encouragement with exercise and support him to explore new opportunities and hobbies.

We're looking for someone with excellent communication skills, a positive approach, and the ability to give time and reassurance when supporting decision-making and choices. A good sense of humour and a person-centered approach are key to success in this rewarding role.

What You’ll Do

· Deliver person-centered care within the client’s own home.

· Maintain safety whilst making positive risk decisions.

· Enrich life and promote independence.

· Build trust and long-term relationships that make every day meaningful.

What We Offer

We value our support workers and provide a benefits package designed to help you thrive:

· Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) – confidential wellbeing support.

· Travel and mileage expenses – reimbursed for your shifts.

· Exceptional pay rates – among the highest in the UK.

· Bespoke training and competency development – keep growing in your career.

What We’re Looking For

We want passionate, resilient professionals who can commit to delivering care without exception. To join our team, you’ll need:

· 12 months UK-based experience in a community setting.

· Confidence in maintaining risk and using physical intervention where required.

· Confidence in utilising PBS standards within services.

· Strong personal values and ethical standards.

· Dedication, commitment and stability.

· A genuine desire to build lasting relationships and make a positive impact.

Why Choose TCS?

Joining Thornbury means joining a compassionate team that values people—not just as clients, but as individuals. You’ll enjoy job satisfaction, and the chance to make a difference that lasts.

Apply Today

Ready to start a role where care goes beyond tasks and becomes a relationship? Click Apply Now and our team will be in touch.

For questions, contact us at:

· Email: ldamhapplications@thornburycommunityservices.co.uk

· Phone: 0333 034 1135

description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Dans le cadre du renforcement des activités Assurance Qualité Stérilité sur un site pharmaceutique spécialisé dans la fabrication de médicaments stériles injectables , nous recherchons un(e) Chargé(e) Assurance Qualité Stérilité pour accompagner les activités de maîtrise de la contamination et de conformité réglementaire. Intégré(e) au sein de l'équipe Assurance Qualité Stérilité et rattaché(e) au Responsable AQ Stérilité, vous contribuerez au maintien de l'état de validation des procédés et environnements stériles, tout en participant aux activités de préparation aux inspections réglementaires. Missions Principales : Rédiger et mettre à jour la documentation relative à l'assurance de stérilité ; Participer aux activités d'évaluation et de maîtrise des risques liés à la contamination microbiologique ; Réaliser et mettre à jour les analyses de risques associées aux procédés, équipements et environnements stériles ; Assurer le suivi des plans d'actions associés aux activités de maîtrise de la contamination ; Participer aux activités d'inspection readiness et de préparation aux inspections réglementaires ; Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques et des systèmes qualité liés aux produits stériles ; Collaborer avec les équipes Qualité, Production, Validation et Support afin de garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires applicables ; Assurer la traçabilité documentaire et le suivi des actions qualité. Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Expérience : Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, avec une première expérience acquise dans un environnement de fabrication de produits stériles et/ou injectables. Compétences : Vous possédez de bonnes qualités rédactionnelles et une première expérience de la gestion documentaire qualité, des analyses de risques et des activités liées à la stérilité. Connaissances techniques : Bonne compréhension des principes de maîtrise de la contamination, des procédés de fabrication stérile et des exigences liées à l'assurance de stérilité. Connaissances réglementaires : Bonne connaissance des BPF/GMP, de l'Annexe 1 des GMP Européennes et idéalement de la norme ISO 14644. Formation : Diplôme scientifique de niveau Bac+5 (Pharmacie, Biologie, Microbiologie, Biotechnologies, Génie des Procédés ou équivalent). Qualités personnelles : Rigueur, capacité d'analyse, esprit de synthèse, autonomie, ouverture d'esprit et force de proposition. Langues : Français courant requis. Un niveau d'anglais professionnel constitue un atout Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. title: Technical Data Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

A Technical Data Analyst is responsible for performing data migration, data conversion and data validation projects for Addepar clients using existing tools and established processes. The ideal candidate will have a good understanding of financial portfolio data, a foundational level of python programming skills, exceptional communication skills and the ability to deliver results in alignment with project deadlines while meeting high quality standards.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Convert, migrate and validate data from external or internal sources using existing tooling with defined processes and workflows
  • Complete data projects on-time meeting project deadlines while adhering to high quality standards
  • Coordinate across project teams communicating regular status updates for assigned data projects and while effectively setting expectations
  • Run python ETL scripts and at times modify, fix or debug as needed
  • Raise keys issues to project team members and senior leadership as necessary
  • Prioritize and context-switch effectively to complete simultaneous projects; seeing each through to the finish line
  • Adhere to project management standard processes
  • Identify and drive opportunities to improve current processes, workflows and tools to increase efficiency and automation.

Who You Are 

  • Minimum 2+ years experience working in technology and finance
  • Fluent in English
  • Experience working with colleagues spread across multiple global locations
  • Proficient in Python programming language and well versed in ETL concepts
  • Understands financial markets and has experience with financial products and portfolio data
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner
  • Solution-oriented and passion for problem solving
  • Highly organized, close attention to detail and driven to make processes more efficient
  • Positive attitude, good work ethic, proactive and a high contributing teammate
  • Independent, adaptable and can work with minimum supervision 
  • Proven ability to manage expectations and provide regular updates to the project team 

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process.
